messages:
zara: OrchardAI says they received a Dedicated overage for 2026-06 that they believe is from a misattributed spill. Can billing ops pull slot attribution?

chris: On it. Do we have invoice ref?

zara: Invoice 2026-06-09 line: DEDICATED_OVERRUN $1,240. They sent a CSV of the timestamps.

billing-bot: Auto-note: Invoice 2026-06-09 for account orchard-ai (acct_8877). Line items:
```
DEDICATED_COMMIT_MONTHLY  1  $7,500.00
DEDICATED_OVERRUN         1  $1,240.00  (2026-06-03 11:05 - 2026-06-03 11:35)
TAX                       1  $372.00
```

chris: Pulled pool logs. Sample: 
```
2026-06-03T11:10:02Z host-7 req=aa112 model=rw-13b tokens=10000 tenant=acct_8877
2026-06-03T11:10:03Z host-7 req=aa113 model=rw-13b tokens=27000 tenant=acct_5533
```
Most tokens map to acct_5533 (partner-sandbox).

zara: If partner-sandbox caused majority of tokens, we should refund Orchard and charge acct_5533. Any objections to credit + chargeback?

mike: No objections. Recommend full refund to Orchard (CM-2026-06-ORCH-01 $1,240) and chargeback CB-2026-06-5533 for the partner portion $1,052 (85%). Also add a $25 goodwill credit to Orchard.

chris: I'll issue the memo and update the invoice. Also filing infra issue to tighten fallback routing for Dedicated pools.

billing-bot: Action: credit memo CM-2026-06-ORCH-01 issued; new invoice 2026-06-09-v2 generated (overrun removed). Chargeback CB-2026-06-5533 created for $1,052.

zara: Orchard confirmed receipt and appreciated the quick turnaround. Closing thread.
